input.quote: ARTICLE VII TECHNICAL SUPPORT SERVICES (a) The Licensor shall provide Technical Support Services relating to the maintenance and support of the Software and the Licensee shall pay the Licensor $2,500 per month for such Technical Support Services.
input.rationale: Platform user fees are purely usage-based (per US$1m traded, Article V and the volume bands), and there is no minimum volume, take-or-pay floor or shortfall penalty on us. However, the $2,500 monthly Technical Support Services fee is mandatory and non-reducible for the entire 36-month Initial Period (p0049), which provides us no termination for convenience. That is a fixed minimum spend of roughly $90,000 with no exit, contrary to the playbook position that fees should be for usage or ordered services only. The minimal fix adds a 30 days' notice right to discontinue or reduce the support services with pro-rated fees and confirms no minimum purchase commitment; the fallback (commitment limited to a 12-month period with a true-up) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Make the fixed monthly support fee cancellable on 30 days' notice and confirm no minimum purchase commitment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The only fixed charge here is the $2,500 monthly support fee, which runs for the full 36-month Initial Period with no right for us to reduce or stop it, so it operates as a minimum spend with no exit. We have added a 30 days' notice right to discontinue or reduce the support services with pro-rated fees, and confirmed that fees are payable only for actual usage and services we order; if you prefer, we can instead cap the commitment at the current 12-month period with a true-up.

ops.oldText: the Licensee shall pay the Licensor $2,500 per month for such Technical Support Services.
ops.newText: the Licensee shall pay the Licensor $2,500 per month for such Technical Support Services, provided that Licensee may discontinue or reduce such Technical Support Services, and the corresponding fees, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, with fees pro-rated to the effective date of such discontinuation or reduction. Licensee has no minimum purchase, volume or spend commitment under this Agreement, and no amounts are payable other than for Licensee's actual usage of the Licensed Technology and services ordered by Licensee.
